item.description: - When you scroll down and the top row slides away, the thin frame round the page slowly takes on the website's own colour and the page's shadow fades, so the page and its frame read as one. Scroll back up and it returns to white. - A bookmarked page's folded corner now stays at the top right of the window, so you see it fold even when you bookmark partway down a page. It lies flat while you scroll down and folds over again when the top row comes back. - On a bookmarked page the scroll bar sits on the frame beside the page, clear of the folded corner. - The bookmarks button in the top row is filled, so it isn't mistaken for the bookmark by the address, which keeps the page you're on.
